say:1:1013514001:1.text: If the previous Syndicate stronghold was where they made the golem cores...
say:1:1013514001:1.source_cn: 如果说之前的黑金营寨，是生产魔偶能源核心的地方——

say:2:1013514002:1.text: Then this camp is where they assemble the golems.
say:2:1013514002:1.source_cn: 那么这里，就是为魔偶装配能源的地方。

say:3:1013514003:0.text: It might be difficult to activate these golems that have been dormant for years...
say:3:1013514003:0.source_cn: 可想而知，要想驱动尘封多年的魔偶，恐怕很难……一蹴而就。

say:4:1013514004:1.text: In order to get them to work, they've been conducting a lot of experiments...
say:4:1013514004:1.source_cn: 他们会进行实验。一次又一次。

choice_prompt:5:1013514004.text: In order to get them to work, they've been conducting a lot of experiments...
choice_prompt:5:1013514004.source_cn: 他们会进行实验。一次又一次。

say:6:1013514005:2.text: So, they picked this place because the Ancient Battlefield has the most sleeping golems?
say:6:1013514005:2.source_cn: 所以他们选择这里，也是因为傀儡古战场沉睡着最多的魔偶吗？

say:9:1013514006:2.text: Yes. They let these golems wander the ruins without considering the harm they might cause to nearby residents!
say:9:1013514006:2.source_cn: 是的，漫漫小姐。他们放任这些魔偶在遗迹群山上游荡，丝毫...

say:10:1013514007:1.text: Additionally, it seems like the so-called "successful pieces" for now are only sent to specific places to cause harm.
say:10:1013514007:1.source_cn: 毕竟，所谓“成功品”的用途——目前看来，也只是被派遣到...

say:11:1013514008:1.text: I can't believe the Syndicate would go to these lengths...
say:11:1013514008:1.source_cn: 黑金商会，居然能做到这种事……

choice:5:0:1.text: Creating flawed pieces in the process.
